ROOT.scriptdef: IF EXISTS (SELECT name FROM sysobjects WHERE name = 'RozliczeniaInsert' AND type = 'TR') DROP TRIGGER CDN.RozliczeniaInsert

CREATE TRIGGER CDN.RozliczeniaInsert ON CDN.Rozliczenia FOR INSERT AS BEGIN UPDATE R2 SET R2.R2_ParID = R2.R2_ID FROM CDN.Rozliczenia R2 JOIN inserted ON R2.R2_ID = inserted.R2_ID WHERE isnull(inserted.R2_ParID,0)=0 END
